identity: GRS north office/laboratory wing, Boltzmannstraße 14, Garching
architect: Detlef Schreiber Architektur und Stadtplanung GmbH
referencePeriod: 1986–1989 project; historical photographs, not a current measured facade survey
referenceUse: Visual reference only. Architect photographs and drawings are not embedded or redistributed.
observations: Two occupied levels with continuous glazing, pale horizontal fascia/spandrels and slender dark frames.
Upper-level projecting vertical members and diagonal braces; lower level has metal curtain-wall framing.
The long wing joins an octagonal stair tower through a narrow bridge at its east end; matching separate survey envelopes establish orientation.
geometry: BVV LoD2 envelope: approximately 47.52 by 12.42 metres, roof retained unchanged.
inferences: Facade bay spacing, frame sections, glazing heights, brace thickness and recess are estimated from photographs within the surveyed envelope.
Pale grey finish and blue-grey opaque glazing are approximate; historical reference photographs are monochrome.
The observed modular rhythm is continued on less-visible elevations. The east bridge junction is retained as an opening.
No interiors, current facade survey, or exact as-built claim.
